a.lede: Meta has placed a complete ban on ads and marketing from TikTok's US minority owner, ByteDance.
a.title: Meta bans TikTok ads from its platforms in tit-for-tat row

b.lede: Since TikTok burst into mainstream consciousness, many things have been called a "TikTok clone": YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels, Snapchat Spotlight, Netflix's Clips, LinkedIn's vertical video feed, and countless other, less recognizable names like Triller, Zynn, and Byte. For years now, Facebook and Instagram have pumped users' feeds with video as Meta chases TikTok's runaway success. […]
b.title: Are you ready for everything to look like TikTok?
